status: Retrospective diagnostic development; class-position pressure summaries and top-five influence were inspected before this fuller analysis. No independent confirmation or post-hoc subgroup deployment.
population: Reuse the exact 1454 opportunity,185 receiving,90 pressure predictions and whole-player identities; no new endpoints, metric tuning or outcome-driven exclusion.
strata: All, draft class, position, class by position, coarse role, strict college identity, corroborated recruiting context, college seasons with raw inputs (0-3), conventional missing count (0,1-2,3+), normalized expert disagreement (<.1,.1-.25,.25+), correction direction, fixed conventional-prediction bands. Outcome-only diagnostics separately label two-year exposure and realized target bands.
exposure: Independently aggregate frozen public NFL REG defensive snaps in draft and draft+1 years. Receiving uses saved two-season NFL targets. Neither is available at draft time; exposure-weighted results and exposure strata are explanatory rather than admissible routing rules. Defensive snaps remain different from pass-rush opportunities.
statistics: Paired loss gain for every group, wins/median/calibration, cohort consistency, conditional stratified-player bootstrap; simultaneous max-standardized bootstrap intervals across groups with n>=10 and >=2 classes, 4000 draws, fixed seed 42871. These intervals exclude refitting, uncertain identity, research selection and new-cohort shift; sparse cohorts prohibit strong confirmation claims. Retain all small cells without promoting them.
mechanism: Exact squared-error correction and equal-average diversity identities; full expert error correlations; all four leave-one-expert-out equal averages as diagnostics. Leave-out-largest-positive-gain sensitivity for k=1,3,5,10 and leave-one-class sensitivity; player influence rows stay outside public GitHub.
consequence: Identify hypotheses that repeat across classes and alternative explanations. Never call an outcome-conditioned stratum a pre-draft feature or choose a scouting model from these subgroup errors. Preserve every earlier negative comparison.
exploratory_amendment: After first full stratification, add all pressure direction/disagreement and position/direction intersections, exposure-weighted group comparisons, common-support class/role identity contrasts and independent integer-pressure reconstruction. These are explanatory follow-ups, not frozen independent hypotheses.
role_control_amendment: After the LB/lower interaction was inspected, evaluate one simple role-mean predictor on every target, prior strength20, only labels from classes at mostY-2. Inspect LB/lower deletion sensitivity. All are retrospective development; no outer choice of prior strength, no model promotion.
